# ForgeCenter

> A Minecraft-themed storefront and creator hub: free tools to make resource packs, modpacks, plugins and mods; Minecraft server hosting; Discord bots; AI site and assistant makers; and a games launchpad. Prices are in orbs (1 orb = 1 US cent).

## Free tools
- [Texture Forge](/textures): build resource packs
- [Modpack Forge](/modpacks): build modpacks from Modrinth
- [Plugin Forge](/plugins): generate Paper plugins
- [Roblox Forge](/roblox): generate Roblox scripts

## Shop and account
- [Orbs](/orbs): buy and spend orbs
- [Games](/games): community games
- [Creators](/creators): creator pages
